pages.text: $(l)Metal needs the Bloomery$()$(br)Your furnace only cooks food and glass now. Four $(item)clay blocks$() (from riverbeds) and four $(item)cobblestone$() make the $(item)Bloomery$(). It's expensive: build one, not five.
Coal is locked this age. Burn logs into $(item)charcoal$() in the Bloomery; it's your fuel until coal unlocks.
Smelt copper and tin. One of each makes two $(item)bronze blend$(); smelt the blend into $(item)bronze$(). You'll need plenty.

$(l)The gate$()$(br)Tools are built from parts, shaped by templates (look them up in JEI). Forge the full bronze set: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword.$(br2)Bronze also unlocks $(thing)MineColonies$(), and $(thing)Farmer's Delight$() opens real cooking.
